title: Report
description:
Effect report of one program (`nurt-report/1`).

Optional fields are omitted from JSON when absent and lists are omitted
when empty, so that the report of an ordinary effect stays short.

kind.description:
Kind of operation: the name of the changing command, or of the source
command of a reading program (for example `replace`, `remove`, `run`,
`find`).

op.description:
Number of the journal entry of the operation, from 1; absent for
reading programs, previews and changing programs without targets.

ran.description:
Canonical text of the program that ran; present only when corrections
were applied.

ast_hash.description:
Hash of the syntax tree: `sha256:` followed by 64 lowercase
hexadecimal digits.

result_file.description:
Path of the file that holds the full result (UTF-8), when the result
was written to a file (`save_to` or `output.results_dir`).

corrections.description: Corrections applied to the program text.

diff.description: Sample of differences on this page.

exec.description: Record of kind `exec` describing a program that ran.

job.description:
Record of kind `job` describing a program that continues in the
background; present when the status is `running`.

test.description: Record of kind `test_run` describing a test run.

analysis.description: Record of kind `analysis` describing an analysis verdict.

git.description:
Record describing the effect on a repository: head before and after,
reference updates and conflicts.

records.description: Records returned by a reading program.

notable.description: Unusual effects, in descending order of severity.

irreversible.description: Irreversible effects; present only when an effect is irreversible.

error.description:
Error that stopped the program, or a check that failed after the
effect was applied.

next_cursor.description: Cursor of the next page; absent on the last page.

ReportStatus.description:
Outcome of a program as a whole.

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `ok` | the program finished; a changing program applied its effect |
| `planned` | preview: targets and effect computed, nothing changed |
| `running` | a program started in the background is still running; the report carries the job |
| `partial` | the effect was applied to part of the targets; the rest is listed in `irreversible` or `error` |
| `rolled_back` | the effect was applied and then reverted because a later check failed |
| `failed` | the program stopped with an error; see `error` |

# Examples

```
use nurt_contracts::report::ReportStatus;

assert_eq!(ReportStatus::RolledBack.as_str(), "rolled_back");
assert_eq!("planned".parse::<ReportStatus>(), Ok(ReportStatus::Planned));
```

Correction.description: A correction applied to the program text before it ran.

id.description: Identifier of the correction within the report, for example `C1`.

rule.description:
Identifier of the correction rule: a letter of the rule table
(`L`, `T`, `V`, `B`, `P`) and two digits, for example `L01`.

kind.description: Kind of corrected element, for example `command` or `param`.

oneOf.description: Certain equivalence: the text differs in notation only.

Structural: a syntax character was added or removed where the
structure is unambiguous.
Fuzzy name: a name was matched by edit distance.
Probable: touches the bounds of a literal or resolves an ambiguity.

TextPosition.description: Position in the program text, counted from 1.

column.description: Column in Unicode scalar values, from 1.

length.description: Length of the corrected text in Unicode scalar values.

files.description: Number of files among the targets.

directories.description: Number of directories among the targets.

bytes.description: Total size of the targets in bytes.

listed.description: Number of entries in [`Report::changes`] on this page.

bytes_before.description: Total size of the changed targets before the change, in bytes.

bytes_after.description: Total size of the changed targets after the change, in bytes.

Change.description: Change of one file within an effect.

raw_path.description:
Native bytes of the path; present only when it is not valid
Unicode, in which case `path` shows the invalid bytes as U+FFFD.

raw_from.description: Native bytes of `from`; present only when it is not valid Unicode.

to.description: New path of a move or a copy.

raw_to.description: Native bytes of `to`; present only when it is not valid Unicode.

rows_changed.description: Rows inserted, updated or deleted by SQL statements.

flags.description: Notes about the change, for example `crlf_preserved`.

raw_link_target.description:
Native bytes of `link_target`; present only when it is not valid
Unicode.

store.description: How the previous content was kept.

irreversible.description:
Reason why the change cannot be undone, for example
`no_space_for_copy`.

before.description:
State before a change of the action `state`, for example
`running`.

after.description: State after a change of the action `state`.

Path.description:
Path in canonical form, used for the path fields of typed records.

Canonical form: `/` as separator, absolute, upper-case drive letter
(`C:/Users/user`), UNC paths as `//server/share`, provider paths with a
prefix (`registry:/HKCU/Software`, `env:/PATH`,
`archive:/home/user/a.zip!/dir/file`). Normalisation is done by the
language implementation; this type only carries the text.

Bytes.description: Binary data, standard base64 with padding.

ChangeAction.description: Action of a change of one file.

Content of an [`Error`].

[`Error`] dereferences to this structure, so the fields are read as

next_steps.description:
Further calls that complete the task, for example the parts of a

Whether the effect of the program is in the world despite the error,

Data specific to the code, for example `path`, `os_error`,

length.description: Number of characters of the erroneous fragment.

stage.description: Execution stage in which the error occurred.

Stage.description:
Execution stage of a program, in execution order.

The JSON form is the stage number as text: `"0"` to `"7"` and `"5a"`. The
executor uses the same type for its execution steps
([`crate::stage::ExecStep`]). The set of stages is fixed by the language.

oneOf.description: `0`, parse: text to surface tree with form correction; no effect.

`1`, bind: binding to the catalog, types, defaults and the effect
class; no effect.
`2`, read: sources and transformations; reads only.
`3`, check: assertions before the effect; no effect.
`4`, plan: targets and the planned effect; previews end here.
`5`, apply: the effect, recorded in the journal.
`5a`, after: stages on the records of the effect; the effect stays.

`6`, verify: the verification pipeline; failure rolls the effect
back.
`7`, report: the effect report.
